meta.title: About us | TourLink
meta.description: TourLink is Central Asia's travel ecosystem — connecting the region with the world through on-the-ground expertise, a transparent platform and routes built by people who know the region from inside.

hero.title: Your link
hero.description: Directly. Unique routes across Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and the wider region — built by a team that knows it from inside.

intro.title: A link between Central Asia and the world
intro.description: TourLink is the region's first comprehensive travel ecosystem — tour operators, agencies, suppliers and travellers on one platform.
intro.paragraph: We connect you with the people who built these routes through years of work in the region — not through aggregators or algorithms. Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan and Turkmenistan — five countries, one link.

mission.title: Connecting Central Asia with the world
mission.description: Giving travellers direct access to the region and the industry access to a global audience.
mission.quote: TourLink is not a startup. It is a team that brought everything it knew and built a platform around it.

vision.title: The main entry point to the region's ecosystem
vision.description: A platform that unites everyone in the industry and sets a new standard of quality and transparency in Central Asian travel.

values.title: How we make decisions
values.description: Seven principles that guide how we work with travellers, agencies and partners.

expertise.title: Inside expertise
expertise.description: We know the region from experience, not from the internet. If we do not know something, we say so — we do not invent it.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: We do what we promise. If something goes wrong, we fix it first — we do not wait for a complaint.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: No hidden terms. Agents see commission, travellers see the full price, partners see how decisions are made.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: We respect everyone's time. Enquiries are handled quickly and the platform avoids unnecessary steps.

passion.title: Passion for the work
passion.description: We love travel and Central Asia. It shows in every tour and every conversation.

respect.title: Respect for the region
respect.description: We talk about Central Asia accurately and respectfully — without clichés or selling exoticism.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.description: Agencies, operators, hotels, guides and travellers are partners, not counterparties. We build long-term relationships.

team.title: People stand behind every route
team.description: Every enquiry starts with a person who helps clarify the language of communication, the shape of the route and the next practical step.

phase_1.label: Phase 1 — present
phase_1.description: Tour operators, travel agencies and individual travellers work on the platform. Ready-made tours and custom programmes on request are available. Partner agents interact with operators through a single interface, see their commission and can request bespoke tours.

phase_2.label: Phase 2 — next step
phase_2.description: Opening the platform to hotels, transport, restaurants and other service providers. Travellers and agents can build a bespoke tour from separate services across suppliers.

phase_3.label: Phase 3 — ecosystem
phase_3.description: A full Central Asian ecosystem: a services marketplace, B2B module for agencies, analytics for operators, tools for guides and integrations with international booking systems.

geography.title: Geography
geography.note: In future — expansion to neighbouring Silk Road destinations while keeping the main focus on Central Asia.

connection.title: Connection at the core
connection.description: TourLink connects sides that would struggle to meet without us — in geography, experience, business and technology.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: The traveller with the real region — not a tourist façade.

business.title: Business
business.description: Travel agencies with a reliable DMC partner in the region.

access.title: Access
access.description: Local operators with a global audience.

not_us.title: What we are not
not_us.description: Sometimes it is easier to define yourself by what you are not — these boundaries matter as much as our promise.

not_ota.because: Behind every tour is a real team, not an algorithm.

not_aggregator.because: We create programmes ourselves and vet our partners.

not_factory.because: Every enquiry is its own story — not a conveyor belt.

not_faceless.because: We have faces, names and stories — and we do not hide them.

not_discovery.because: We have known the region for years. It is simply more accessible now.

cta.title: Ready to open Central Asia?
cta.description: Browse ready-made routes or write to us — we will connect you with the team that knows the region from inside.
